entries.meaningZh: APAS：Ariel Performance Analysis System，三维运动分析系统名称
entries.en: The team used APAS to analyse the runner's movement.
entries.zh: 团队使用APAS三维运动分析系统分析了跑步者的动作。

entries.meaningZh: 不进食的；缺乏进食的，旧医学形容词，不作现代诊断名称
entries.en: The old case description calls the patient apastic.
entries.zh: 旧病例描述用apastic表示患者不进食。

entries.meaningZh: apathia：apathy的历史或拉丁化形式，淡漠、缺乏情感反应
entries.en: The old clinical text describes the lack of interest as apathia.
entries.zh: 旧临床著作用apathia描述这种缺乏兴趣的状态。

entries.meaningZh: apatropine：apoatropine的异体，阿朴阿托品，化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical index cross-references apatropine with apoatropine.
entries.zh: 化学索引将apatropine与阿朴阿托品的另一拼写交叉列示。

entries.meaningZh: APBA：American Power Boat Association，美国动力艇协会
entries.en: The race programme lists APBA as the governing organisation.
entries.zh: 赛事日程将美国动力艇协会列为管理组织。

entries.meaningZh: APCs：armoured personnel carriers的复数缩写，装甲运兵车
entries.en: The museum displays photographs of early APCs.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了早期装甲运兵车的照片。

entries.meaningZh: APD：avalanche photodiode，雪崩光电二极管
entries.en: The detector uses an APD to register the faint pulse.
entries.zh: 探测器使用雪崩光电二极管记录微弱的脉冲。

entries.meaningZh: APDS：armour-piercing discarding sabot，脱壳穿甲弹，军事器材名称
entries.en: The museum label identifies the exhibit as APDS ammunition.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签将展品标为脱壳穿甲弹。

entries.meaningZh: 猿样手，描述某些手部外观的旧临床术语，通常分写ape hand
entries.en: The clinical atlas illustrates the posture traditionally called ape hand.
entries.zh: 临床图谱展示了传统上称为猿样手的姿势。

entries.meaningZh: apecs：旧数据误写；所指常用缩写APEC，Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation，亚太经济合作组织
entries.en: The report summarises the APEC meeting.
entries.zh: 报告概述了亚太经济合作组织会议。

entries.meaningZh: 形态渐失，旧生物学术语
entries.en: The old developmental diagram illustrates apeidosis.
entries.zh: 旧发育示意图展示了形态逐渐消失的过程。

entries.meaningZh: aperception：apperception的历史形式，统觉；把新经验与既有认知联系起来
entries.en: The philosophy class discussed apperception rather than simple sensation.
entries.zh: 哲学课讨论的是统觉，而不只是简单感觉。

entries.meaningZh: 非周期性记录图，旧仪器学用语
entries.en: The instrument produced an aperiodograph rather than a repeating wave pattern.
entries.zh: 仪器生成了非周期性记录图，而不是重复的波形。

entries.meaningZh: aperto：意大利语开放的、开阔的，亦用于音乐表情术语
entries.en: The score marks the passage aperto.
entries.zh: 乐谱用aperto标示这个乐段应演奏得开阔。

entries.meaningZh: apertum：拉丁语开放的这一词形；本例为外语语法说明，不把旧数据横室义直接当作现代英语用法
entries.en: The Latin glossary translates apertum as open in this sentence.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表在这句话中将apertum译为开放的。

entries.meaningZh: 光阑或孔径限定作用，技术用语
entries.en: The optical model includes the effect of aperturing.
entries.zh: 光学模型考虑了孔径限定作用的影响。

entries.meaningZh: Apestrin：促性腺激素相关制剂的历史名称；不据此推定现行配方或疗效
entries.en: The historical pharmacy catalogue includes Apestrin.
entries.zh: 历史药房目录收录了Apestrin。

entries.meaningZh: 心尖搏动，通常分写apex beat
entries.en: The clinician recorded the position of the apex beat.
entries.zh: 临床医师记录了心尖搏动的位置。

entries.meaningZh: APF：animal protein factor，动物蛋白因子，旧营养学术语
entries.en: The historical nutrition paper discusses APF in animal feed.
entries.zh: 历史营养学论文讨论了动物饲料中的动物蛋白因子。

entries.meaningZh: APFT：almost-periodic Fourier transform，殆周期傅里叶变换，数学专业缩写
entries.en: The paper defines APFT before applying it to the signal.
entries.zh: 论文在将殆周期傅里叶变换用于信号之前，先对该缩写作了定义。

entries.meaningZh: APG：alkyl polyglucoside，烷基多糖苷，一类表面活性剂
entries.en: The formulation uses an APG as a surfactant.
entries.zh: 该配方使用一种烷基多糖苷作为表面活性剂。

entries.meaningZh: APHA：American Public Health Association，美国公共卫生协会
entries.en: The student presented a poster at an APHA meeting.
entries.zh: 学生在美国公共卫生协会的一次会议上展示了海报。

entries.meaningZh: 指趾骨缺如，医学术语
entries.en: The anatomical report describes aphalangia affecting one hand.
entries.zh: 解剖报告描述了一只手的指骨缺如。

entries.meaningZh: 隐藻素或相关藻类色素的旧名称，具体成分依原资料
entries.en: The historical pigment table records aphanicin.
entries.zh: 历史色素表记载了aphanicin这一旧名称。

entries.meaningZh: 器官消失或退化的旧生物学名称
entries.en: The old developmental diagram illustrates aphanisia of the temporary organ.
entries.zh: 旧发育图展示了临时器官的退化消失。

entries.meaningZh: 隐球藻属，蓝细菌的一类属名
entries.en: The water sample contained a colony identified as Aphanocapsa.
entries.zh: 水样中含有一群被鉴定为隐球藻属的蓝细菌。

entries.meaningZh: 隐晶斑岩；具有隐晶基质的斑状岩，旧岩石学名称
entries.en: The field collection includes a small block of aphanophyre.
entries.zh: 野外藏品中有一小块隐晶斑岩。

entries.meaningZh: 不显原质团，黏菌学中的原质团类型名称
entries.en: The mycologist sketched the aphanoplasmodium under magnification.
entries.zh: 真菌学家在放大观察下画出了不显原质团。

entries.meaningZh: 超显微生物类，早期对不可见或滤过性病原体的历史分类名称
entries.en: The historian explained the old category Aphanozoa.
entries.zh: 历史研究者解释了超显微生物类这一旧分类。

entries.meaningZh: 失读症相关的旧医学名称；不是单纯视力下降
entries.en: The historical index cross-references aphemesthesia with alexia.
entries.zh: 历史索引将aphemesthesia与失读症交叉列示。

entries.meaningZh: 远金星点，绕金星轨道上距金星最远的位置
entries.en: The simulated probe reached aphesperian on its orbit around Venus.
entries.zh: 模拟探测器在绕金星轨道上到达了远金星点。

entries.meaningZh: 厌恶工作，罕见旧词，不作为一般医学诊断使用
entries.en: The old essay uses aphilopony to describe an aversion to work.
entries.zh: 旧文章用aphilopony形容对工作的厌恶。

entries.meaningZh: 不能大笑的旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical symptom index includes aphonogelia.
entries.zh: 历史症状索引收录了不能大笑这一旧称症状。

entries.meaningZh: 分离、排除或耐受力缺失相关的旧术语，具体义依原文
entries.en: The historian explains aphoresis using the original medical context.
entries.zh: 历史研究者依据原医学语境解释了aphoresis这一旧词。

entries.meaningZh: 影像幻视或影幻视的旧名称，须依原医学描述理解
entries.en: The old case notes describe the visual experience as aphose.
entries.zh: 旧病例笔记将这种视觉体验称为影幻视。

entries.meaningZh: 黑电气石的历史名称
entries.en: The mineral collection includes a dark sample labelled aphrizite.
entries.zh: 矿物藏品中有一块标记为黑电气石旧名aphrizite的深色标本。

entries.meaningZh: aphroaisiac：误拼；标准词形aphrodisiac，催情的；相关功效须另有证据
entries.en: The historian examined products advertised as aphrodisiac.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了被宣传为催情用品的产品。

entries.meaningZh: Aphrodisin：历史产品名称，亦可见于不同生物化学命名；本例仅作旧制剂标签使用
entries.en: The archive records the maker's name beside the Aphrodisin label.
entries.zh: 档案在Aphrodisin标签旁记录了生产者名称。

entries.meaningZh: 泡沫状或多孔火山岩的旧名称
entries.en: The geologist compared the porous aphrolite with denser rock.
entries.zh: 地质学家将多孔的泡沫岩与较致密的岩石作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 辨解能力缺失的旧医学名称；不应作为现代泛化标签称呼他人
entries.en: The historical medical glossary records aphronia.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表收录了aphronia这一旧名称。

entries.meaningZh: 语音不清的旧医学名称
entries.en: The old speech assessment describes aphthenxia.
entries.zh: 旧言语评估描述了语音不清。

entries.meaningZh: 印度鲱类小鱼的旧名称，具体物种依原分类确定
entries.en: The old fish catalogue includes an aphua specimen.
entries.zh: 旧鱼类目录中有一件印度鲱类小鱼标本。

entries.meaningZh: 防御力缺失，旧免疫学术语
entries.en: The historical immunology chapter discusses aphylaxis.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学章节讨论了防御力缺失。

entries.meaningZh: APIC：advanced programmable interrupt controller，高级可编程中断控制器
entries.en: The operating system routes the interrupt through the APIC.
entries.zh: 操作系统通过高级可编程中断控制器处理这个中断。

entries.meaningZh: 根尖定位器，牙科仪器名称
entries.en: The dentist checked the apicolocator before recording the measurement.
entries.zh: 牙医记录测量值前检查了根尖定位器。

entries.meaningZh: 牙根尖造口术，旧牙科学术语
entries.en: The historical dental register records an apicostomy.
entries.zh: 历史牙科登记册记载了一例根尖造口术。

entries.meaningZh: apiczon：旧数据误拼；标准品牌名称Apiezon，真空油脂等产品的名称
entries.en: The equipment record specifies Apiezon grease for the seal.
entries.zh: 设备记录为该密封处指定了Apiezon真空脂。

entries.meaningZh: Apilak：蜂王浆相关产品的名称；不据此推定功效或统一配方
entries.en: The product archive includes an Apilak label.
entries.zh: 产品档案中有一张Apilak标签。

entries.meaningZh: 牙根尖定位器，apicolocator的少见形式
entries.en: The equipment list includes an apilocator for the dental clinic.
entries.zh: 设备清单中有一台供牙科诊所使用的根尖定位器。

entries.meaningZh: Apinol：松油类制剂的历史名称，具体组成依原产品
entries.en: The old pharmacy collection contains an Apinol bottle.
entries.zh: 旧药房藏品中有一只Apinol药瓶。

entries.meaningZh: apioectomy：旧数据误拼；标准词形apicoectomy，牙根尖切除术
entries.en: The dental record includes a note about an apicoectomy.
entries.zh: 牙科病历中有一条关于根尖切除术的记录。

entries.meaningZh: 芹菜酮，旧化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical index lists apione among the plant-derived compounds.
entries.zh: 化学索引将芹菜酮列在植物来源化合物之中。

entries.meaningZh: 芹菜酮醇，旧化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical archive preserves an apionol reference card.
entries.zh: 化学档案保存着一张芹菜酮醇参考卡。

entries.meaningZh: 蜂毒的旧名称，亦见其他生化命名，本例限历史蜂毒义
entries.en: The historical text discusses apisin in a section on bee venom.
entries.zh: 历史著作在蜂毒一节中讨论了apisin这一旧称。

entries.meaningZh: APIU：Army Photo Interpretation Unit，陆军照片判读单位的历史缩写
entries.en: The archived photograph carries an APIU identification number.
entries.zh: 这张存档照片上有一个陆军照片判读单位的识别编号。

entries.meaningZh: 无球差状态；消球差，光学术语
entries.en: The lens design aims for aplanasia across the useful field.
entries.zh: 镜头设计力求在有效视场内实现无球差。

entries.meaningZh: Aplectrum：美洲一类兰花的属名，不是A rum这一断词
entries.en: The herbarium catalogues the orchid under Aplectrum.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆将这株兰花编在Aplectrum属下。

entries.meaningZh: aplilalia：旧数据误拼；按重复言语义采用palilalia，复言症
entries.en: The clinical description distinguishes palilalia from ordinary hesitation.
entries.zh: 临床描述区分了复言症与普通的说话犹豫。

entries.meaningZh: apling：旧数据关联APL编程语言；标准名称为APL，不把该旧形式当作规范语言名
entries.en: The programmer wrote the matrix operation in APL.
entries.zh: 程序员用APL写出了这个矩阵运算。

entries.meaningZh: aplphobia：旧数据误拼；标准名称apiphobia，对蜜蜂的恐惧
entries.en: Her apiphobia made walking near the hives difficult.
entries.zh: 她对蜜蜂的恐惧使她难以走近蜂箱。

entries.meaningZh: aplsnogamete：误拼；标准词形aplanogamete，不动配子
entries.en: The diagram contrasts an aplanogamete with a motile gamete.
entries.zh: 示意图将不动配子与能动配子作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 海兔紫素，海兔相关色素的旧名称
entries.en: The biochemical archive records an aplysiopurpurin extract.
entries.zh: 生化档案记载了一份海兔紫素提取物。

entries.meaningZh: APM：application performance monitoring，应用性能监控
entries.en: The team used APM to locate the slow request.
entries.zh: 团队利用应用性能监控找到了响应缓慢的请求。

entries.meaningZh: APN：access point name，移动网络接入点名称
entries.en: The phone stored the APN in its mobile-network settings.
entries.zh: 手机将接入点名称保存在移动网络设置中。

entries.meaningZh: APNA：American Psychiatric Nurses Association，美国精神科护士协会
entries.en: The nurse attended an educational session organised by APNA.
entries.zh: 这位护士参加了美国精神科护士协会组织的教学活动。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴β刺桐定，化合物名称；不提供制备或用药建议
entries.en: The chemical catalogue includes apo-beta-erythroidine.
entries.zh: 化学目录收录了阿朴β刺桐定。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴乌头碱，化合物名称；不提供制备或用药建议
entries.en: The analytical paper lists apoaconitine among the identified compounds.
entries.zh: 分析论文将阿朴乌头碱列在已鉴定的化合物之中。

entries.meaningZh: 脱玻安山岩，旧岩石学名称
entries.en: The geologist compared apoandesite with the neighbouring volcanic rock.
entries.zh: 地质学家将脱玻安山岩与邻近火山岩作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: apoatropin：apoatropine的异体，阿朴阿托品
entries.en: The chemical register uses the standard spelling apoatropine.
entries.zh: 化学登记册使用了阿朴阿托品的标准拼写apoatropine。

entries.meaningZh: 脱玻玄武岩，旧岩石学名称
entries.en: The field collection contains an apobasalt sample.
entries.zh: 野外藏品中有一份脱玻玄武岩样品。

entries.meaningZh: 分离担子，旧真菌学术语
entries.en: The old mycology plate illustrates an apobasidium.
entries.zh: 旧真菌学图版画出了一枚分离担子。

entries.meaningZh: 排出或流产相关的旧医学名称，具体义须按原文
entries.en: The historian explains apobole within the original case description.
entries.zh: 历史研究者在原病例描述中解释了apobole这一旧词。

entries.meaningZh: Apoc：Apocalypse的传统缩写，可指启示录
entries.en: The manuscript cites Apoc. 12 in the margin.
entries.zh: 手稿在页边引用了启示录第十二章。

entries.meaningZh: Apocain：历史局部麻醉产品名称，来源可能不一；不据此将其与任一种现代药名直接等同
entries.en: The archive records the manufacturer beside the Apocain package.
entries.zh: 档案在Apocain包装旁记录了生产商。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴樟脑或脱甲樟脑，历史化合物名称
entries.en: The historical chemical catalogue records apocamphor.
entries.zh: 历史化学目录记载了阿朴樟脑。

entries.meaningZh: 泻除；排泄，旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical medical text discusses apocatharsis.
entries.zh: 历史医学著作讨论了泻除这一旧概念。

entries.meaningZh: 泻除的；促进排泄的旧医学形容词，不代表现代用药建议
entries.en: The historical pharmacy text classifies the preparation as apocathartic.
entries.zh: 历史药学著作将该制剂归为泻除类。

entries.meaningZh: 厌食；拒绝进食的旧医学名称
entries.en: The old symptom index records apocleisis.
entries.zh: 旧症状索引记载了厌食这一旧称。

entries.meaningZh: 远土星点，绕土星轨道上距土星最远的位置
entries.en: The orbital model marks the spacecraft's apocronus.
entries.zh: 轨道模型标出了航天器的远土星点。

entries.meaningZh: 强烈想离家旅行的状态，罕见历史用词，与思乡相反
entries.en: His apodemialgia returned whenever he studied a map.
entries.zh: 每当研究地图时，他强烈想远行的心情就会再次涌现。

entries.meaningZh: 无足类，历史动物分类名称，不能不加语境地套用于现代所有类群
entries.en: The old zoology textbook places the illustrated animals under Apodes.
entries.zh: 旧动物学教材将图示动物归在无足类之下。

entries.meaningZh: 无足目，一类缺少管足的海参所属的目
entries.en: The marine biologist catalogued the sea cucumber under Apodida.
entries.zh: 海洋生物学家将这只海参编在无足目之下。

entries.meaningZh: APOE：apolipoprotein E的基因符号，载脂蛋白E基因；蛋白常写apoE
entries.en: The genetics paper reports variation in APOE.
entries.zh: 遗传学论文报告了载脂蛋白E基因的变异。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴葑烯，旧化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical archive preserves a reference record for apofenchene.
entries.zh: 化学档案保存着一条阿朴葑烯参考记录。

entries.meaningZh: 远银心点，天体轨道上距银河中心最远的位置
entries.en: The model places the star near apogalacteum.
entries.zh: 模型将这颗恒星置于远银心点附近。

entries.meaningZh: apogamia：apogamy的历史形式，无配子融合的生殖；不把所有类型简单等同于孤雌生殖
entries.en: The botany course compares apogamy with fertilisation.
entries.zh: 植物学课程将无配子融合生殖与受精作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 无配子结合的生殖，旧植物繁殖术语，须依原分类解释
entries.en: The old botany scheme includes apogamogony among its reproductive categories.
entries.zh: 旧植物学图式将无配子结合生殖列为繁殖类别之一。

entries.meaningZh: 阿朴棉酚，化合物名称；不提供制备或用药建议
entries.en: The analytical study compared apogossypol with the reference material.
entries.zh: 分析研究将阿朴棉酚与参考材料作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: apohyllite：误拼；标准词形apophyllite，鱼眼石
entries.en: The mineral collector labelled the specimen apophyllite.
entries.zh: 矿物收藏者将标本标记为鱼眼石。

entries.meaningZh: 性选择；择偶选择的旧名称
entries.en: The old biology text discusses apolegamy in its chapter on mating.
entries.zh: 旧生物学教材在交配一章中讨论了性选择这一旧称。

entries.meaningZh: 分泌、排泄或某种功能停止的旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical glossary uses apolepsis for a function that has ceased.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用apolepsis表示某种功能停止。

entries.meaningZh: 闭止或功能停止的旧医学名称，与apolepsis相关的形式
entries.en: The historical glossary uses apolipsis for a cessation of function.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用apolipsis表示功能停止。

entries.meaningZh: Apolo：Apollo在西班牙语等语言中的形式，阿波罗；英语通常用Apollo
entries.en: The English museum label names the figure Apollo.
entries.zh: 博物馆的英语标签将这个形象标为阿波罗。

entries.meaningZh: 连续配子世代相关的旧植物学名称，须依原生活史体系解释
entries.en: The older life-cycle scheme includes apomictosis.
entries.zh: 较早的生活史图式中列有apomictosis。

entries.meaningZh: apomixia：apomixis的历史异体，无融合生殖
entries.en: The botany course contrasts apomixis with sexual reproduction.
entries.zh: 植物学课程将无融合生殖与有性生殖作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 认知功能缺陷的过时医学标签；不应作为一般称呼或现代诊断词使用
entries.en: The historian explains why aponea belongs to an older diagnostic vocabulary.
entries.zh: 历史学家解释了为何aponea属于过时的诊断词汇。

entries.meaningZh: Aponomma：爬行蜱类的历史属名，分类地位依所采用体系而定
entries.en: The old collection labels the tick Aponomma.
entries.zh: 旧藏品把这只蜱标记为Aponomma属。

entries.meaningZh: 防御力减退，早期免疫学的旧名称
entries.en: The historical paper links apophylaxis with diminished defensive capacity.
entries.zh: 历史论文将防御力减退与apophylaxis这一旧名称联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: apophyse：apophysis的历史形式，岩枝或侵入体的小分支，地质学语境
entries.en: The geologist mapped an apophysis branching from the main intrusion.
entries.zh: 地质学家绘出了从主侵入体分出的岩枝。

entries.meaningZh: 血浆缺乏，旧医学术语
entries.en: The old medical index records apoplasmia.
entries.zh: 旧医学索引记载了血浆缺乏。

entries.meaningZh: 质体缺失，植物细胞学术语
entries.en: The old cytology report records apoplastidy in the cells.
entries.zh: 旧细胞学报告记载了细胞中的质体缺失。

entries.meaningZh: apoplutnian：非标准或损坏形式，原资料指远冥王星点；本例用明确描述，不把它作为规范术语教授
entries.en: The model marks the point farthest from Pluto on the orbit.
entries.zh: 模型标出了轨道上距离冥王星最远的位置。

entries.meaningZh: apoplylaxis：旧数据误拼，通常对应apophylaxis，防御力减退的旧名称
entries.en: The historical medical glossary records apophylaxis as diminished defensive capacity.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表将apophylaxis记为防御力减退。

entries.meaningZh: 孔界区或槽间区域，孢粉学术语，具体范围依原形态体系
entries.en: The pollen diagram marks the apoporium between the apertures.
entries.zh: 花粉图在孔口之间标出了孔界区域。

entries.meaningZh: 变斑岩；由变质或变形作用形成的斑状岩，旧岩石学名称
entries.en: The field collection includes a banded specimen of apoporphyry.
entries.zh: 野外藏品中有一块带条带构造的变斑岩标本。

entries.meaningZh: 晕厥，旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical case notes describe the fainting episode as apopsychia.
entries.zh: 历史病例笔记用apopsychia描述这次晕厥。

entries.meaningZh: 出水孔；海绵鞭毛室的出水开口，不是人体肛门的通用名称
entries.en: Water leaves the chamber through the apopyle.
entries.zh: 水通过出水孔离开该室。

entries.meaningZh: 离花序轴的；背向花序主轴的，植物学用语
entries.en: The botanical drawing shows the aporachial side of the structure.
entries.zh: 植物学图展示了该结构背向花序轴的一侧。

entries.meaningZh: 阿普雷因，历史生物碱名称；不提供制备或用药建议
entries.en: The phytochemical index lists aporeine among the reported alkaloids.
entries.zh: 植物化学索引将阿普雷因列在所报告的生物碱之中。

entries.meaningZh: 脱玻流纹岩，旧岩石学名称
entries.en: The geologist selected a piece of aporhyolite from the outcrop.
entries.zh: 地质学家从露头选取了一块脱玻流纹岩。

entries.meaningZh: 无孔目，历史动物分类名称，须按原分类体系解释
entries.en: The historical classification chart includes Aporidea.
entries.zh: 历史分类图中列有无孔目。

entries.meaningZh: 非珠孔受精；花粉管不经珠孔进入胚珠的情况
entries.en: The botany diagram contrasts aporogamy with entry through the micropyle.
entries.zh: 植物学示意图将非珠孔受精与经珠孔进入的情况作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 鼻液溢流；流鼻液，旧医学名称
entries.en: The old case notes describe nasal discharge as aporrhinosis.
entries.zh: 旧病例笔记用aporrhinosis描述鼻液溢流。

entries.meaningZh: apos：apostrophe的缩写，撇号；也可为apostrophes的缩略复数，须看表头
entries.en: The editing table uses apos. to mark a missing apostrophe.
entries.zh: 编辑表用apos.标示缺少撇号的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 具有相似警戒色的一组生物，动物学术语，不仅指一个仿色个体
entries.en: The zoologist grouped the similarly warning-coloured insects into an aposeme.
entries.zh: 动物学家将这些具有相似警戒色的昆虫归为一组。

entries.meaningZh: 缺少孢子生殖，aposporogony的异体或旧形式
entries.en: The old classification uses aposporogeny for the absence of sporogony.
entries.zh: 旧分类用aposporogeny表示缺少孢子生殖。

entries.meaningZh: 缺少或不进行孢子生殖，旧生物学术语
entries.en: The old life-cycle diagram illustrates aposporogony.
entries.zh: 旧生活史示意图展示了不发生孢子生殖的情况。

entries.meaningZh: Arga：阿尔加河，流经西班牙纳瓦拉的河流。本例取河名，不采用原数据中未核实的计算机缩写扩展。
entries.en: We followed the footpath along the Arga through Pamplona.
entries.zh: 我们沿着阿尔加河畔的步道穿过了潘普洛纳。

entries.meaningZh: 简直是；几乎就是（常强调令人惊讶的程度）
entries.en: Finishing the bridge in a month was little short of a miracle.
entries.zh: 一个月就建成这座桥，简直是个奇迹。

entries.meaningZh: mal-：坏的；不良的；异常的
entries.en: Mal- gives malfunction the sense of working badly.
entries.zh: 前缀mal-使malfunction带有运转不正常的意思。

entries.meaningZh: max.：maximum的缩写；最大值；最高限额
entries.en: The notice beside the lift says max. eight people.
entries.zh: 电梯旁的告示写着最多可乘八人。

entries.meaningZh: meet的过去式和过去分词；遇见；会面
entries.en: We met at the station and walked to the library together.
entries.zh: 我们在车站会面，然后一起步行去图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: mid-：中间的；中期的
entries.en: Mid- places midwinter in the middle of the winter season.
entries.zh: mid-使midwinter表示冬季的中间时段。

entries.meaningZh: min.：minimum的缩写；最小值；最低限度
entries.en: The form lists the required age as min. eighteen years.
entries.zh: 表格上列出的最低年龄要求为十八岁。

entries.meaningZh: 不当销售；以误导或不适合的方式出售金融等产品
entries.en: The bank investigated complaints of mis-selling unsuitable insurance.
entries.zh: 银行调查了有关不当销售不合适保险产品的投诉。

entries.meaningZh: must-：构成must-see等词，表示值得或必须做的
entries.en: The review called the exhibition a must-see, using must- to recommend it strongly.
entries.zh: 那篇评论称这场展览为必看展览，用must-来强烈推荐它。

entries.meaningZh: 国家政府；中央政府（相对于地方政府）
entries.en: The national government sets the rules, while local councils manage the parks.
entries.zh: 中央政府制定规则，地方议会则管理公园。

entries.meaningZh: neuro-：神经的；与神经系统有关的
entries.en: Neuro- connects neuroscience with the study of the nervous system.
entries.zh: neuro-将neuroscience与神经系统研究联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 相当出色的；绝非微不足道的
entries.en: Carrying the piano up those stairs was no mean achievement.
entries.zh: 把钢琴搬上那段楼梯，实在是件了不起的事。

entries.meaningZh: 不信任的（常用于vote of no confidence或no-confidence motion）
entries.en: The committee rejected a no-confidence motion against its chair.
entries.zh: 委员会否决了针对主席的不信任动议。

entries.meaningZh: 非军官的；没有军官委任状的（用于军衔）
entries.en: A non-commissioned officer showed the recruits how to inspect their equipment.
entries.zh: 一名士官向新兵演示了如何检查装备。

entries.meaningZh: 没有差别；难分高下（在比赛等语境中）
entries.en: With both runners reaching the line together, there was nothing in it.
entries.zh: 两名选手同时冲线，实在难分高下。

entries.meaningZh: 勉强算得上的；不太像样的
entries.en: We built a shelter of sorts from branches and an old sheet.
entries.zh: 我们用树枝和一条旧床单搭了一个勉强能遮蔽的棚子。

entries.meaningZh: 下班的；不在值勤的
entries.en: An off-duty firefighter noticed the smoke and called for help.
entries.zh: 一位休班的消防员发现烟雾，打电话求援。

entries.meaningZh: op. cit.：在前引著作中（引文标记）
entries.en: The footnote uses op. cit. to refer back to the historian's earlier-cited book.
entries.zh: 脚注用op. cit.指回此前引用过的那位历史学家的著作。

entries.meaningZh: operandi：拉丁语词形，见modus operandi；表示运作或行事的方式
entries.en: The detective compared the burglar's modus operandi with that of earlier cases.
entries.zh: 侦探将这名窃贼的作案手法与先前案件中的手法作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 或诸如此类的东西；或什么的
entries.en: Bring a notebook, a tablet, or whatever you normally use for taking notes.
entries.zh: 带一本笔记本、一台平板，或任何你平时用来记笔记的东西。

entries.meaningZh: 禁止进入的；不许涉足的
entries.en: The old quarry is out of bounds to visitors.
entries.zh: 游客不得进入那座旧采石场。

entries.meaningZh: 非婚生地；在婚姻关系之外
entries.en: The novel examines how children born out of wedlock were treated in that period.
entries.zh: 这部小说探讨了那个时期非婚生子女受到的对待。

entries.meaningZh: over-：过度；过量；超过正常程度
entries.en: Over- adds the idea of too much in overcook and overspend.
entries.zh: over-在overcook和overspend中带有过度的意思。

entries.meaningZh: p.a.：per annum；每年
entries.en: The advertisement lists the rent as twelve thousand pounds p.a.
entries.zh: 广告列出的租金为每年一万二千英镑。

entries.meaningZh: 支付卡；付款用的银行卡等卡片
entries.en: The kiosk accepts a payment card but does not take cash.
entries.zh: 这台自助服务机接受支付卡付款，但不收现金。

entries.meaningZh: photo-：光；与光有关的
entries.en: In photosensitive, photo- indicates that the material reacts to light.
entries.zh: 在photosensitive中，photo-表示这种材料会对光产生反应。

entries.meaningZh: 熟石膏；巴黎石膏
entries.en: The sculptor poured plaster of Paris into the mould and left it to set.
entries.zh: 雕塑家把熟石膏浆倒进模具，让它凝固。

entries.meaningZh: pls：please的非正式书面缩写；请
entries.en: Her message read, Pls send the address before noon.
entries.zh: 她发来的消息写着：请在中午之前把地址发过来。

entries.meaningZh: politico-：政治的；与政治有关的
entries.en: The report uses politico-economic to link political choices with economic effects.
entries.zh: 报告用politico-economic把政治选择与经济影响联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 粉蓝色；浅灰蓝色；这种颜色的
entries.en: She chose powder blue curtains to match the pale walls.
entries.zh: 她挑选了粉蓝色窗帘，与浅色墙壁相配。

entries.meaningZh: pro-：支持；赞成（本例所取前缀义）
entries.en: Pro- in pro-democracy shows support for democracy.
entries.zh: pro-democracy中的pro-表示支持民主。

entries.meaningZh: 建立特征档案；分析某一类人或事物的特征
entries.en: Customer profiling helped the shop understand which services visitors needed.
entries.zh: 顾客特征分析帮助商店了解访客需要哪些服务。

entries.meaningZh: pseudo-：假的；貌似而非的
entries.en: Pseudo- warns that pseudoscience lacks the standards of genuine science.
entries.zh: pseudo-提示pseudoscience缺乏真正科学应有的标准。

entries.meaningZh: 表达清楚；使人理解并接受观点
entries.en: The diagrams helped her put across a difficult idea.
entries.zh: 这些图表帮助她把一个难懂的观点解释清楚。

entries.meaningZh: 漫无边际地说下去；絮叨不休
entries.en: He began to ramble on about holidays we had never heard of.
entries.zh: 他开始漫无边际地讲起那些我们从未听说过的度假经历。

entries.meaningZh: re-：再；重新；返回
entries.en: Adding re- turns write into rewrite, meaning to write again.
entries.zh: 加上re-便把write变为rewrite，意思是重新写。

entries.meaningZh: 挂号投递；有投递凭证的邮寄服务（英式用语）
entries.en: She sent the signed contract by recorded delivery.
entries.zh: 她通过附有投递凭证的挂号邮寄服务寄出了签好的合同。

entries.meaningZh: ride的过去分词；骑过；乘坐过
entries.en: I had never ridden a horse before that summer.
entries.zh: 在那个夏天之前，我从未骑过马。

entries.meaningZh: 决选；第一轮未决出结果后的投票
entries.en: The two leading candidates faced each other in a run-off.
entries.zh: 得票领先的两位候选人在决选中再次对决。

entries.meaningZh: 第二议院；两院制议会中的另一院，通常指上院
entries.en: The bill must also be examined by the second chamber.
entries.zh: 这项法案还必须交由第二议院审议。

entries.meaningZh: semi-：半；部分；不完全
entries.en: Semi- in semicircle describes half of a circle.
entries.zh: semicircle中的semi-表示圆的一半。

entries.meaningZh: 冷淡而草率的对待；不耐烦的拒绝（常见于give/get short shrift）
entries.en: The plan received short shrift at the meeting and was dismissed within minutes.
entries.zh: 这个计划在会上受到冷淡对待，几分钟内就被否决了。

entries.meaningZh: 大声说出；喊出
entries.en: Sing out if you need another pair of hands.
entries.zh: 如果需要别人帮忙，就大声招呼一声。

entries.meaningZh: skip的现在分词；跳绳
entries.en: The children were skipping in the playground during the break.
entries.zh: 课间时，孩子们在操场上跳绳。

entries.meaningZh: 就其所达到的程度而言；在有限范围内
entries.en: Your explanation is correct so far as it goes, but it leaves out the main cause.
entries.zh: 你的解释在已涉及的范围内是对的，但漏掉了主要原因。

entries.meaningZh: 寻找和取得货源；采购
entries.en: Local sourcing reduced the distance the vegetables had to travel.
entries.zh: 本地采购缩短了蔬菜需要运输的距离。

entries.meaningZh: 起跑器；帮助短跑运动员起跑的装置
entries.en: He adjusted the left starting block before placing his foot against it.
entries.zh: 他先调好左侧起跑器，然后把脚抵在上面。

entries.meaningZh: sub-：在……下面；次于；下级的
entries.en: Sub- in subzero means below zero.
entries.zh: subzero中的sub-表示低于零。

entries.meaningZh: 【英式口语】再见；拜拜
entries.en: Ta-ta, she said, waving as the bus pulled away.
entries.zh: 公交车驶离时，她挥着手说：拜拜。

entries.meaningZh: techno-：技术；与技术有关的
entries.en: Techno- links technophobia to a fear of technology.
entries.zh: techno-使technophobia与对技术的恐惧联系起来。

entries.meaningZh: 在……之前；不到……的时候
entries.en: We will be lucky to finish this side of Christmas.
entries.zh: 我们要是能在圣诞节前完工，就算幸运了。

entries.meaningZh: 大意是；意思是说
entries.en: We received a note to the effect that the meeting had been postponed.
entries.zh: 我们收到一张便条，大意是会议已延期。

entries.meaningZh: trans-：横过；穿越；跨越
entries.en: Trans- in transatlantic describes movement across the Atlantic.
entries.zh: transatlantic中的trans-表示横跨大西洋。

entries.meaningZh: 参加选拔；试演以争取加入
entries.en: She decided to try out for the school basketball team.
entries.zh: 她决定参加学校篮球队的选拔。

entries.meaningZh: uber-／über-：超；极其（非正式强调用法）
entries.en: The headline used uber- in uber-rich to stress exceptional wealth.
entries.zh: 标题在uber-rich中使用uber-，强调极其富有。

entries.meaningZh: under-：不足；低于应有程度
entries.en: Under- gives underpaid the meaning of being paid too little.
entries.zh: under-使underpaid表示报酬过低。

entries.meaningZh: VB：Visual Basic；一种程序设计语言的名称缩写
entries.en: The old payroll tool was written in VB.
entries.zh: 旧的工资计算工具是用VB编写的。

entries.meaningZh: 街头民意采访；普通公众的简短意见
entries.en: The radio programme ended with a vox pop about bus fares.
entries.zh: 广播节目以一段有关公交票价的街头民意采访结束。

entries.meaningZh: wholegrain的名词复数；全谷物
entries.en: The loaf contains wholegrains rather than only refined flour.
entries.zh: 这条面包含有全谷物，而不只是精制面粉。

entries.meaningZh: 写信回复；回信
entries.en: Please write back when you know your travel dates.
entries.zh: 确定出行日期后，请回信告诉我。

entries.meaningZh: 国际收支；通常用复数形式balance of payments
entries.en: The economist examined the country's balance of payments before discussing its currency.
entries.zh: 经济学家在讨论该国货币之前，先考察了它的国际收支。

entries.meaningZh: 基础工作；准备工作；通常连写为groundwork
entries.en: The survey laid the groundwork for a larger study.
entries.zh: 这项调查为一项更大规模的研究奠定了基础。

entries.meaningZh: 大陆；本土；通常连写为mainland
entries.en: The ferry carries passengers from the island to the mainland.
entries.zh: 渡轮把乘客从岛上送往大陆。

entries.meaningZh: 哲学博士学位；研究型博士学位的通称
entries.en: She is completing a Ph.D. in applied mathematics.
entries.zh: 她正在攻读应用数学博士学位。

entries.meaningZh: put something out：扑灭；熄灭
entries.en: The firefighters put the warehouse fire out before it reached the next building.
entries.zh: 消防员在火势蔓延到隔壁楼房之前扑灭了仓库的大火。

entries.meaningZh: take something off：脱下；摘下
entries.en: Please take your muddy boots off before coming inside.
entries.zh: 进屋之前，请把沾满泥的靴子脱下来。

entries.meaningZh: tie something up：用绳等捆好；扎紧
entries.en: She tied the parcel up with string before carrying it to the post office.
entries.zh: 她先用细绳把包裹捆好，然后拿到邮局。

entries.meaningZh: 【俚语】经常使用LSD等致幻剂的人；该称呼可能带贬义
entries.en: The memoir describes how the label acid head followed him long after he stopped using LSD.
entries.zh: 回忆录写道，即使他早已停止使用LSD，那个称他为LSD常用者的绰号仍一直跟着他。

entries.meaningZh: 空对地导弹
entries.en: The museum displayed an air-to-surface missile beside a model aircraft.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一架飞机模型旁展出了一枚空对地导弹。

entries.meaningZh: 来回地；往复地
entries.en: She moved the chair backward and forward until all four legs were steady.
entries.zh: 她把椅子来回挪动，直到四条腿都稳稳落地。

entries.meaningZh: Beaux-Arts：学院派古典建筑风格，常具有对称、宏大和繁复装饰等特点
entries.en: The station's Beaux-Arts entrance has a grand staircase and ornate stonework.
entries.zh: 这座车站的学院派古典风格入口设有宏大的楼梯和华丽的石雕装饰。

entries.meaningZh: blue-pointed：蓝灰色重点色的，指猫的面部、耳、足和尾等末端颜色
entries.en: The blue-pointed cat had grey-blue ears and a pale coat.
entries.zh: 这只蓝灰重点色猫的耳朵呈灰蓝色，躯干的毛色较浅。

entries.meaningZh: 细纹小牛皮；一种用于鞋等制品的光滑小牛皮革
entries.en: The shoemaker cut the upper from a piece of black box calf.
entries.zh: 鞋匠从一块黑色细纹小牛皮上裁出了鞋面。

entries.meaningZh: 【旧化学名称之一】四氯乙烯；此处指C2Cl4，需结合具体文献区分名称用法
entries.en: The archive lists carbon dichloride as an older name for tetrachloroethylene.
entries.zh: 档案把carbon dichloride列为四氯乙烯的一个旧名称。

entries.meaningZh: 柑橘粉虱；一种可侵害柑橘等植物的粉虱
entries.en: The grower found citrus whitefly on the undersides of several leaves.
entries.zh: 种植者在几片叶子的背面发现了柑橘粉虱。

entries.meaningZh: 亲民作风；与普通人自然相处的能力
entries.en: Despite his formal title, the mayor never lost the common touch.
entries.zh: 尽管有正式的头衔，这位市长一直保持着平易近人的作风。

entries.meaningZh: 蔓越莓酱
entries.en: She served cranberry sauce with the roast vegetables.
entries.zh: 她把蔓越莓酱与烤蔬菜一起端上桌。

entries.meaningZh: 体积计量；容积单位制
entries.en: The worksheet asks pupils to convert units of cubic measure.
entries.zh: 练习要求学生换算体积计量单位。

entries.meaningZh: 码头设施；停靠设施
entries.en: The harbour plans to replace its ageing docking facility.
entries.zh: 港口计划更换老化的停靠设施。

entries.meaningZh: 低下头；弯身躲避（另有鸭绒的名词义，此处不取）
entries.en: Duck down so the branch does not hit your head.
entries.zh: 低下头，别让树枝打到你的头。

entries.meaningZh: easy-going：随和的；不紧张的
entries.en: Her easy-going manner helped the new students relax.
entries.zh: 她随和的态度让新生们放松下来。

entries.meaningZh: 遵从；与他人保持一致
entries.en: The smaller suppliers had to fall in line with the new safety rules.
entries.zh: 较小的供应商也必须遵守新的安全规定。

entries.meaningZh: 田间持水量；土壤在多余重力水排出后保留的水量
entries.en: The researcher measured the soil's field capacity after excess water had drained away.
entries.zh: 多余的水排出后，研究人员测量了土壤的田间持水量。

entries.meaningZh: 时断时续；间歇地（常用于in fits and starts）
entries.en: Work on the roof continued in fits and starts whenever the rain stopped.
entries.zh: 每逢雨停，屋顶工程就时断时续地继续进行。

entries.meaningZh: 真菌感染
entries.en: The laboratory examined the sample for signs of a fungal infection.
entries.zh: 实验室检查了样本中是否有真菌感染的迹象。

entries.meaningZh: 遗传指纹；用于个体识别的DNA特征模式
entries.en: The team compared the genetic fingerprint from the sample with the reference profile.
entries.zh: 团队将样本的遗传指纹与参考特征谱作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 【法律】重大盗窃罪；通常按特定司法辖区的财产价值等标准区分
entries.en: The prosecutor charged the suspect with grand larceny under state law.
entries.zh: 检察官依据州法律控告该嫌疑人犯有重大盗窃罪。

entries.meaningZh: Hageman因子；凝血因子XII，不是因子VII
entries.en: The laboratory report refers to factor XII as Hageman factor.
entries.zh: 实验室报告把凝血因子XII称为Hageman因子。

entries.meaningZh: 严重麻烦；严厉责骂或惩罚（常用于there will be hell to pay）
entries.en: There will be hell to pay if we lose the only copy of the contract.
entries.zh: 要是把合同的唯一副本弄丢了，我们可就有大麻烦了。

entries.meaningZh: 角鸮；头顶有角状羽簇的鸮类
entries.en: A horned owl watched the clearing from a branch above us.
entries.zh: 一只角鸮从我们上方的树枝上注视着林间空地。

entries.meaningZh: 躲藏着；隐匿中
entries.en: The witness remained in hiding until the trial began.
entries.zh: 证人一直藏匿着，直到审判开始。

entries.meaningZh: 等渗摩溶液；与参照液具有相同渗透浓度的溶液；不一定等张
entries.en: The experiment compared an isosmotic solution with the reference fluid.
entries.zh: 实验将一种与参照液具有相同渗透浓度的溶液与参照液作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 司法程序；法院审理程序
entries.en: The documents became evidence in a judicial proceeding.
entries.zh: 这些文件在一项司法程序中成为证据。

entries.meaningZh: lady's slipper：兜兰或杓兰等具有囊状唇瓣的兰花；不是凤仙花
entries.en: The lady's slipper opened a pouch-shaped flower beside the woodland path.
entries.zh: 林间小路旁，那株杓兰开出了一朵囊状的花。

entries.meaningZh: 液量计量；液体容量单位
entries.en: The recipe book includes a table of liquid measure for cups and millilitres.
entries.zh: 食谱附有杯与毫升之间的液量换算表。

entries.meaningZh: 生命物质；构成活细胞的物质（泛称）
entries.en: The microscope revealed tiny droplets of living substance moving inside the cell.
entries.zh: 显微镜显示，细胞内有微小的生命物质液滴在移动。

entries.meaningZh: 【气象】马尾状卷云；亦作mare's-tail
entries.en: A mare's tail stretched across the pale evening sky.
entries.zh: 一条马尾状卷云横伸在淡色的暮空中。

entries.meaningZh: 胰腺纤维化；胰腺中纤维组织增多，不等同于囊性纤维化这一病名
entries.en: The pathology report described pancreatic fibrosis in the tissue sample.
entries.zh: 病理报告描述了组织样本中的胰腺纤维化。

entries.meaningZh: proto-的无连字符形式；原始的；最早的；前期的
entries.en: Proto- in proto-language points to an earlier ancestral language.
entries.zh: proto-language中的proto-指向更早的祖语。

entries.meaningZh: 绯红肉杯菌；具有鲜红色杯状子实体的一类真菌俗名
entries.en: A scarlet cup stood out against the dark, decaying wood.
entries.zh: 一朵绯红肉杯菌在深色的腐木上格外醒目。

entries.meaningZh: 石色灯草鹀；暗眼灯草鹀的石色类型
entries.en: A slate-colored junco searched for seeds beneath the feeder.
entries.zh: 一只石色灯草鹀在喂鸟器下方寻找种子。

entries.meaningZh: 短纤维；具有有限长度的纺织纤维，可以是天然或人造的
entries.en: The mill blends staple fiber before spinning it into yarn.
entries.zh: 工厂先把短纤维混合，再把它们纺成纱线。

entries.meaningZh: 吸入泵；抽吸泵
entries.en: The suction pump drew water out of the flooded cellar.
entries.zh: 抽吸泵把水从被淹的地下室抽了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 青蒿；黄花蒿（Artemisia annua）
entries.en: The botanist pressed a sweet wormwood specimen for the herbarium.
entries.zh: 植物学家把一份青蒿标本压制好，供植物标本馆收藏。

entries.meaningZh: tera-：国际单位制词头，表示10的12次方，即万亿倍
entries.en: Tera- makes one terawatt equal to a trillion watts.
entries.zh: 词头tera-使一太瓦等于一万亿瓦。

entries.meaningZh: 氧化钛；常指二氧化钛，但具体化学式须依上下文确定
entries.en: The pigment supplier identified the titanium oxide as titanium dioxide.
entries.zh: 颜料供应商确认，这种氧化钛是二氧化钛。

entries.meaningZh: 符号货币；面值大于其材料本身价值的货币
entries.en: The lecture contrasted token money with coins valued mainly for their metal.
entries.zh: 这堂课将符号货币与主要按金属本身计价的硬币作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 高音谱表；使用高音谱号的五线谱表
entries.en: The melody is written on the treble staff above the bass part.
entries.zh: 旋律写在低音声部上方的高音谱表上。

entries.meaningZh: 姜黄根茎；烹饪上常称姜黄根，不是白毛茛
entries.en: She grated fresh turmeric root into the soup.
entries.zh: 她把新鲜姜黄根茎擦成碎末，放进汤里。

entries.meaningZh: 高地鹬；upland sandpiper的旧名，虽名plover但并非鸻科鸟
entries.en: The old field guide lists the upland plover among grassland birds.
entries.zh: 那本旧野外指南把高地鹬列为草原鸟类。

entries.meaningZh: 黄绿色的；略带黄色的绿色
entries.en: The young leaves were yellowish green when they first opened.
entries.zh: 嫩叶刚展开时呈黄绿色。

entries.meaningZh: 为说法提供证据或支持
entries.en: Can you back your claim up with figures from the report?
entries.zh: 你能用报告中的数据来支持你的说法吗？

entries.meaningZh: 做好心理准备；使自己振作以迎接困难
entries.en: I braced myself before opening the letter with the examination result.
entries.zh: 拆开装着考试结果的信之前，我先做好了心理准备。

entries.meaningZh: 与……冲突；彼此抵触
entries.en: His wish to travel collided with his need to save money.
entries.zh: 他想去旅行的愿望与攒钱的需要发生了冲突。

entries.meaningZh: 妨碍某人自在表现；使某人放不开手脚
entries.en: Having my manager watch every step really cramps my style.
entries.zh: 经理盯着我的一举一动，实在让我放不开手脚。

entries.meaningZh: 反复追问，才从某人口中问出某事
entries.en: We had to drag the full story out of him one detail at a time.
entries.zh: 我们只好一个细节一个细节地追问，才从他口中问出事情的全部经过。

entries.meaningZh: 终于抽出时间或着手做原先打算做的事
entries.en: I finally got round to repairing the loose door handle.
entries.zh: 我终于抽出时间修好了松动的门把手。

entries.term: get to the bottom of something
entries.meaningZh: 查明真相；弄清根本原因
entries.en: The engineer checked every connection to get to the bottom of the fault.
entries.zh: 工程师检查了每个连接点，以查明故障的根本原因。

entries.meaningZh: 受到某人欢迎；得到良好反应
entries.en: The shorter working week went down well with the staff.
entries.zh: 缩短工作周的安排很受员工欢迎。

entries.meaningZh: 指责、数落或冲某人发火
entries.en: Please do not have a go at her before you hear what happened.
entries.zh: 在听清事情经过之前，请别责骂她。

entries.meaningZh: 面临艰巨任务；得费很大劲才能完成
entries.en: With half the team absent, we had our work cut out finishing the order.
entries.zh: 团队有一半人缺席，我们得费很大劲才能完成这份订单。

entries.meaningZh: 耐心听某人把话说完
entries.en: I disagreed with him, but I heard him out before replying.
entries.zh: 我虽然不同意他的观点，还是听他把话说完才作答。

entries.meaningZh: 猛然使某人从某种状态中惊醒
entries.en: A sharp knock jerked me out of a pleasant daydream.
entries.zh: 一阵急促的敲门声把我从愉快的白日梦中惊醒。

entries.meaningZh: 瞒着某人；不让某人知道有关情况
entries.en: They kept the volunteers in the dark about the change of venue.
entries.zh: 他们没有把更换地点的事告诉志愿者。

entries.term: make a song and dance about something
entries.meaningZh: 对某事大做文章；小题大做
entries.en: He made a song and dance about a delay of only five minutes.
entries.zh: 不过耽搁了五分钟，他却对此大做文章。

entries.meaningZh: 指出某人的错误；责问或纠正某人
entries.en: The tutor pulled me up on a quotation I had copied incorrectly.
entries.zh: 导师指出了我抄错的一处引文。

entries.meaningZh: 把某事归因于……
entries.en: She put the missing files down to a mistake during the move.
entries.zh: 她把文件丢失归因于搬迁时的一次失误。

entries.meaningZh: 看穿伪装、借口或不真诚的表现
entries.en: The children saw through his excuse and asked for a proper explanation.
entries.zh: 孩子们看穿了他的借口，要求他好好解释。

entries.meaningZh: 看某人的反应来决定行动；以某人的举动为信号
entries.en: I took my cue from the host and stood when the guests entered.
entries.zh: 我照着主人的举动，在客人进来时站了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 误会某人的话或用意；把话听成冒犯
entries.en: I meant to help, but he took my suggestion the wrong way.
entries.zh: 我本来想帮忙，他却误会了我的建议。

entries.term: toy with the idea of doing something
entries.meaningZh: 随意考虑做某事；有过念头但尚未认真决定
entries.en: She toyed with the idea of opening a small bookshop by the sea.
entries.zh: 她曾动过在海边开一家小书店的念头。

entries.meaningZh: 使某人筋疲力尽；耗尽体力或精力
entries.en: Looking after the stall all day wore us out.
entries.zh: 照看了一整天摊位，我们累得筋疲力尽。
